status: FIRST PASS (M1). Lumped models, ASSUMED regression law and efficiencies. Geometry is stable to ~+/-10 % (grain length is the most uncertain dimension: depends on the unverified N2O/ABS helical-port regression law). v2 will follow with the quasi-1D port model, non-equilibrium tank, gnc.json duty cycles.
units: SI (m, kg, s, N, Pa, K, J, W) unless the key says otherwise
conventions: x_face = axial distance from the injector face toward the nozzle exit [m]. CAD +Z points forward (nozzle -> injector), so z_CAD = x_exit_face - x_face. Contour CSV radii are gas-side wall radii.

throttle_architecture.v: Servo-driven variable-area pintle (needle-in-seat) injector at the head end + separate normally-closed main isolation valve upstream (tank side, off-gimbal)
throttle_architecture.tag: LEAD decision 2026-10-11 (REQUIREMENTS rev 1); trade study in 02-combustion/REPORT.md confirms (no showstopper)

expansion_ratio.tag: DERIVED: floor separation trade (Schmucker) for 8:1 stretch, see eps_floor_trade; eps=3 (v0) separates (Schmucker) already at 20 % thrust; eps=2 stays attached to ~14 %, incipient lip separation at 12.5 % (eps_sep 1.89); Isp cost at max -3.5 % vs eps=3

design_OF_at_max_thrust.tag: DERIVED: lean of c* peak (5.5) so throttling sweeps through the optimum (floor_trade); lumped model value at initial port

fuel.tag: REQ founder/LEAD; ABS card verified: c* within +/-0.3 % across literature compositions and hf sources (cea_cards.py)

igniter.v: Spark-ignited N2O/propane torch (N2O tapped from the injector manifold), radial into the pre-chamber
igniter.tag: DERIVED first-pass choice (trade in progress: arc-ABS needs O2/Nytrox assist with N2O; pyro cartridges limited starts); may change in v2 with a CHANGELOG line

tank_pressurisation.v: Self-pressurised N2O, conditioned 20 +/- 3 C (N2 supercharge trade pending in v2)

OD_m.tag: LEAD v0 placeholder 6061-T6 2.5 in tube [m] (Mechanical owns)

thickness_m.tag: DERIVED: phenolic liner wall [m] (Mechanical owns final)

chamber_inner_diameter_m.tag: DERIVED (liner ID); pre- and post-chamber gas-side diameter = grain OD + 0.4 mm = 0.0539 m

material.v: ABS, FDM printed, 100 % infill, concentric/helical perimeters

outer_diameter_m.tag: DERIVED: grain OD [m] = liner ID 53.95 mm - 0.45 mm diametral clearance

length_m.tag: DERIVED: shortest grain giving O/F~7.6 at max thrust with nominal law [m]

type.v: single helical port (round section), helix along the axis

initial_diameter_m.tag: DERIVED: initial port diameter [m] (G_ox0 ~ 450 kg/m2/s at max)

density_kg_m3.tag: ASSUMED printed ABS density [kg/m3] (filament 1.04; FDM parts 0.975-1.01: Walker 2015, McFarland & Antunes 2019); weigh grains

regression_law.form: r = helix_factor * a * G_ox^n  (r m/s, G_ox kg/m2/s)

a.tag: ASSUMED N2O/ABS regression coefficient [m/s per (kg/m2/s)^n]; anchored to ~1 mm/s at 300 kg/m2/s for HTPB/N2O (Boughaba & Hendrick, EUCASS 2013, citing lit.); NO verified N2O/ABS law found -> band x0.6..x1.5

n.tag: ASSUMED flux exponent (band 0.35-0.68; GOX polymer laws n=0.50-0.68, Zilliac & Karabeyoglu AIAA 2006-4504 Table 2)

helix_factor.tag: ASSUMED helical-port regression amplification for N2O (GOX/ABS up to 3.0x: Walker, USU MS thesis 2015; N2O UNVERIFIED) band 1.0-2.5

regression_law.note: No verified N2O/ABS law found in accessible literature; design is checked across a x0.6..x1.5, n 0.35-0.68, helix 1.0-2.5. First static fires must measure it.

grain.retention: forward face seats on the pre-chamber insulator shoulder; aft face on post-chamber insulator; anti-rotation key (Mechanical)

pre_chamber.wall: phenolic insulator; injector face is the forward wall

post_chamber.wall: phenolic insulator, graphite or phenolic convergent entry

floor_stretch_12p5pct.status: feed stiffness OK (dP/Pc ~7-10); nozzle lip separation incipient (eps_sep 1.89 vs 2.0); hybrid low-flux combustion (G_ox 74 -> ~30 kg/m2/s as port grows) is the main unverified risk - see REPORT stability section

tank_pressure_range_Pa.tag: DERIVED: initial 4.78-5.40 MPa for 20 +/- 3 C conditioning (CoolProp Psat), up to 5.65 MPa at 25 C; equilibrium adiabatic blowdown to liquid depletion ends near 3.0-3.3 MPa (max-thrust run: 3.25 MPa)

thrust_ceiling_rule.tag: DERIVED stability rule: injector dP/Pc >= 0.25 sets the thrust ceiling (chug, see stability section)

valves_and_actuators.architecture: tank -> NC main isolation valve (off-gimbal) -> PTFE-lined braided flex hose across gimbal -> 40 um filter -> pintle injector (on gimbal)

force_pressure_envelope_N.tag: DERIVED: + = toward chamber (closing). Seated at MEOP: pressure holds needle closed with +77 N; wide open at MEOP: -87 N (stem area x P). Reference geometry seat 5.5 / stem 4.0 mm

seal_friction_N.tag: ASSUMED upper bound, PTFE spring-energised seal on 4 mm stem at 7 MPa (vendor data to confirm)

full_stroke_time_s.tag: DERIVED from ENG-03 (10-90 % thrust <= 100 ms target with ~3 ms chamber fill + fuel lag)

position_resolution_m.tag: DERIVED: <= 2 % thrust resolution needs <= 0.05 mm; 10 um gives margin at the floor

small_signal_bandwidth_Hz.tag: ASSUMED (match ENG-07 class until gnc.json sets the Pc-loop bandwidth)

pintle_actuator_requirements.fail_state: spring-to-close preferred (not safety-critical: the NC isolation valve is the safety barrier)
pintle_actuator_requirements.example_implementation: hobby/industrial servo (>= 0.7 N m) on a 3.8 mm crank: 60 deg = 4 mm; F = T/r -> 0.65 N m for 170 N (Electronics selects)

isolation_valve_requirements.type: normally-closed, fail-closed (spring return or NC solenoid), full port

Cv_min.tag: DERIVED: <= 0.5 bar at 0.25 kg/s liquid N2O (rho ~800)

close_time_max_s.tag: DERIVED: thrust shutoff is done by the pintle (<= 50 ms); isolation follows

isolation_valve_requirements.materials: PTFE/PCTFE seats, FKM, oxygen-cleaned, Krytox only
isolation_valve_requirements.trapped_liquid: segment between isolation valve and closed pintle must be relieved (vented-ball cavity relief to the tank side, or a thermal relief valve <= 7.5 MPa)

plant_model_valve_to_Pc.form: Pc(s)/h(s) = K_h * [(1 - phi) + phi/(tau_f s + 1)] * exp(-tau_d s) / (tau_c s + 1)

K_h_Pa_per_m.tag: SIM m1_design.py v1 (lumped 0D: equilibrium tank, Dyer injector, lumped helical port, CEA ABS_TYP_v1) secant slopes of the 20 C throttle map (initial port)

phi.tag: DERIVED: fraction of the static gain carried by the fuel flow ~ (1-n)/(1+O/F) .. 1/(1+O/F)

tau_f_s.tag: DERIVED: solid-phase thermal lag kappa_s/r^2 with ABS diffusivity ~1e-7 m2/s (LITERATURE-UNVERIFIED) and r 1.0-0.45 mm/s

plant_model_valve_to_Pc.tank_pressure_sensitivity: K_h scales ~ with sqrt(P1 - Pc) (SPI part) to G_crit(P1) (HEM part): feed-forward on measured tank/injector-inlet pressure

duty_assumptions.v: Until gnc.json exists: (A) bounding case = max thrust held to liquid depletion (~6.05 s) for FEA thermal; (B) provisional flight duty = 3.5 s at 100 % (ascent) / 8-10 s coast / relight / 6-8 s at 25-60 % (landing) / soak-back >= 300 s. Grain web protects the case in the grain zone; pre/post-chamber and nozzle get the CSV BCs.

thermal_and_loads.thrust_misalignment_note: Helical port is axisymmetric on average; asymmetric regression may produce small side forces - not quantified in v1

unknowns_and_open_items: N2O/ABS (and PETG) regression law: no verified literature law; static-fire characterisation required (band used: a x0.6-1.5, n 0.35-0.68, helix 1.0-2.5).
Pintle Cd and two-phase flow at small lifts: water then N2O cold flow (REPORT test plan).
Low-flux (G_ox < ~50 kg/m2/s) combustion at the 12.5 % stretch floor: efficiency and stability unverified.
Duty cycles from gnc.json not yet available.
Tank geometry/load from Mechanical/GNC (v0 placeholders 2.5 L / 1.6 kg used).
Igniter choice is first-pass (torch); trade completes in REPORT v2.
